title: DPDPAEvent
description: A single unit of telemetry ingested from a Blinkit system source (log line or API payload). This schema is frozen after Phase 0 — do not modify without a full team review.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event. Format: UUID v4.

source_type.description: Whether this event originated from an application log line or an API request/response payload.

source_system.description: The Blinkit microservice or system that emitted this event. Used by auditors to break down violations by system.

timestamp.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of when the event was emitted by the source system.

raw_snippet.description: The raw log line or API payload string as received. Used for audit evidence and human review. Must never be modified after ingestion.

fields.description: Extracted key-value pairs from the raw_snippet. Keys are field names (e.g. 'aadhaar', 'phone'); values are the corresponding raw values. Open map — different source systems carry different fields.
